items.name: Breath Weapon
entries: You can use your action to exhale destructive energy in a 5-foot-wide, 30-foot-long line.

When you use your breath weapon, each creature in the area of the exhalation must make a Dexterity saving throw. The DC for this saving throw equals 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus. A creature takes {@damage 2d6} fire damage on a failed save, and half as much damage on a successful one. The damage increases to {@damage 3d6} at 6th level, {@damage 4d6} at 11th level, and {@damage 5d6} at 16th level.
After you use your breath weapon, you can't use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

entries: Dragonborn are taller and heavier than humans, standing well over 6 feet tall and averaging almost 250 pounds. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Breath Weapon
entries: You can use your action to exhale destructive energy in a 15-foot cone.

When you use your breath weapon, each creature in the area of the exhalation must make a Constitution saving throw. The DC for this saving throw equals 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus. A creature takes {@damage 2d6} cold damage on a failed save, and half as much damage on a successful one. The damage increases to {@damage 3d6} at 6th level, {@damage 4d6} at 11th level, and {@damage 5d6} at 16th level.
After you use your breath weapon, you can't use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

entries: You have resistance to cold damage.

entries: Humans reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

entries.name: Size

texts.fr: Habitué aux profondeurs de l’Outreterre, tu possèdes une vision supérieure dans l’obscurité et la lumière faible. Tu vois à 120 pieds dans une lumière faible comme dans une lumière vive, et dans les ténèbres comme dans une lumière faible. Tu ne distingues pas les couleurs dans les ténèbres, seulement des nuances de gris.
Sensibilité à la lumière du soleil

Tu subis un désavantage aux jets d’attaque et aux tests de Sagesse ({@skill Perception}) basés sur la vue lorsque toi, la cible de ton attaque ou ce que tu essaies de percevoir est directement exposé au soleil.

Tu connais le sort mineur {@spell dancing lights}. Au niveau 3, tu peux lancer le sort {@spell faerie fire} une fois avec ce trait et récupères cette capacité après un repos long. Au niveau 5, tu peux aussi lancer {@spell darkness} une fois par jour avec ce trait et récupères cette capacité après un repos long. Le Charisme est ta caractéristique d’incantation pour ces sorts.
Tu as la maîtrise des {@item rapier|phb|rapières}, des {@item shortsword|phb|épées courtes} et des {@item hand crossbow|phb|arbalètes de poing}.

entries.name: Trance
entries: Elves don't need to sleep. Instead, they meditate deeply, remaining semiconscious, for 4 hours a day. (The Common word for such meditation is "trance.") While meditating, you can dream after a fashion; such dreams are actually mental exercises that have become reflexive through years of practice. After resting in this way, you gain the same benefit that a human does from 8 hours of sleep.

entries.name: Age
entries: Although elves reach physical maturity at about the same age as humans, the elven understanding of adulthood goes beyond physical growth to encompass worldly experience. An elf typically claims adulthood and an adult name around the age of 100 and can live to be 750 years old.

entries.name: Size
entries: Elves range from under 5 to over 6 feet tall and have slender builds. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Accustomed to twilit forests and the night sky, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Keen Senses

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put you to sleep.

entries.name: Trance
entries: Elves don't need to sleep. Instead, they meditate deeply, remaining semiconscious, for 4 hours a day. (The Common word for such meditation is "trance.") While meditating, you can dream after a fashion; such dreams are actually mental exercises that have become reflexive through years of practice. After resting in this way, you gain the same benefit that a human does from 8 hours of sleep.
{@note If you meditate during a long rest, you finish the rest after only 4 hours. You otherwise obey all the rules for a long rest; only the duration is changed.}

entries: A halfling reaches adulthood at the age of 20 and generally lives into the middle of his or her second century.

entries.name: Size

entries.name: Halfling Nimbleness
entries: You can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.

entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and Halfling. The Halfling language isn't secret, but halflings are loath to share it with others. entries.name: Tinker
entries: You have proficiency with {@item artisan's tools|PHB} ({@item tinker's tools|phb}). Using those tools, you can spend 1 hour and 10 gp worth of materials to construct a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 hp). The device ceases to function after 24 hours (unless you spend 1 hour repairing it to keep the device functioning), or when you use your action to dismantle it; at that time, you can reclaim the materials used to create it. You can have up to three such devices active at a time.
When you create a device, choose one of the following options:

entries.name: Clockwork Toy
entries: This toy is a clockwork animal, monster, or person, such as a frog, mouse, bird, dragon, or soldier. When placed on the ground, the toy moves 5 feet across the ground on each of your turns in a random direction. It makes noises as appropriate to the creature it represents.

entries.name: Fire Starter
entries: The device produces a miniature flame, which you can use to light a candle, torch, or campfire. Using the device requires your action.

entries.name: Music Box
entries: When opened, this music box plays a single song at a moderate volume. The box stops playing when it reaches the song's end or when it is closed.

texts.fr: Lorsque tu effectues un test d’Intelligence ({@skill History}) lié aux objets magiques, aux objets alchimiques ou aux dispositifs technologiques, tu peux ajouter deux fois ton bonus de maîtrise au lieu de tout bonus de maîtrise normalement appliqué.

Tu as la maîtrise de {@item artisan's tools|PHB} ({@item tinker's tools|phb}). Avec ces outils, tu peux consacrer 1 heure et 10 po de matériaux à un dispositif mécanique de taille TP (CA 5, 1 point de vie). Il cesse de fonctionner après 24 heures, sauf si tu passes 1 heure à le réparer pour le maintenir, ou lorsque tu utilises ton action pour le démonter ; tu peux alors récupérer les matériaux utilisés. Tu peux avoir jusqu’à trois dispositifs actifs à la fois.
À la création d’un dispositif, choisis une option :

Ce jouet est un animal, monstre ou personnage mécanique, comme une grenouille, une souris, un oiseau, un dragon ou un soldat. Posé au sol, il se déplace de 5 pieds à chacun de tes tours dans une direction aléatoire. Il émet les bruits appropriés à la créature représentée.
Le dispositif produit une petite flamme pour allumer une bougie, une torche ou un feu de camp. L’utiliser exige ton action.
Ouverte, cette boîte joue une seule chanson à volume modéré. Elle s’arrête à la fin du morceau ou lorsqu’on la referme.

entries: You have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and Gnomish. The Gnomish language, which uses the Dwarvish script, is renowned for its technical treatises and its catalogs of knowledge about the natural world.

entries.name: Artificer's Lore
entries: Whenever you make an Intelligence ({@skill History}) check related to magic items, alchemical objects, or technological devices, you can add twice your proficiency bonus, instead of any proficiency bonus you normally apply.

entries.name: Tinker
entries: You have proficiency with {@item artisan's tools|PHB} ({@item tinker's tools|phb}). Using those tools, you can spend 1 hour and 10 gp worth of materials to construct a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 hp). The device ceases to function after 24 hours (unless you spend 1 hour repairing it to keep the device functioning), or when you use your action to dismantle it; at that time, you can reclaim the materials used to create it. You can have up to three such devices active at a time.
When you create a device, choose one of the following options:

entries.name: Clockwork Toy
entries: This toy is a clockwork animal, monster, or person, such as a frog, mouse, bird, dragon, or soldier. When placed on the ground, the toy moves 5 feet across the ground on each of your turns in a random direction. It makes noises as appropriate to the creature it represents.

entries.name: Fire Starter
entries: The device produces a miniature flame, which you can use to light a candle, torch, or campfire. Using the device requires your action.

entries.name: Music Box
entries: When opened, this music box plays a single song at a moderate volume. The box stops playing when it reaches the song's end or when it is closed.

entries.name: Age
entries: Gnomes mature at the same rate humans do, and most are expected to settle down into an adult life by around age 40. They can live 350 to almost 500 years.

entries.name: Size
entries: Gnomes are between 3 and 4 feet tall and average about 40 pounds. Your size is Small.
